name: architecture-samples
description_en: A collection of samples to discuss and showcase different architectural tools and patterns for Android apps.
readme_excerpt: Android Architecture Samples These samples showcase different architectural approaches to developing Android apps. In its different branches you'll find the same app (a TODO app) implemented with small differences. In this branch you'll find: User Interface built with Jetpack Compose A single-activity architecture, using Navigation Compose. A presentation layer that contains a Compose screen (View) and a ViewModel per screen (or feature). Reactive UIs using Flow and coroutines for asynchronous…
